say:3:1220423001:0.text: Tell us the truth now! Where have you taken Miss Wendy?!
say:3:1220423001:0.source_cn: 快说实话！你们把温蒂小姐带到哪里去了？

say:4:1220423002:0.text: Bah! If our boss finds out, he and his sister, along with you lot, will all be doomed!
say:4:1220423002:0.source_cn: 呸！要是我们大老板知道了，他和他妹妹，还有你们这些人，...

say:5:1220423003:0.text: Our boss is a major player with connections all over Rustport!
say:5:1220423003:0.source_cn: 我们大老板可是锈锚港手眼通天的人物！

say:6:1220423004:0.text: Let me handle this little interrogation.

say:8:1220423006:0.text: Wow, Lucca, Chippy thought you didn't want to get involved!
say:8:1220423006:0.source_cn: 哇，卢卡，满满还以为你真的对这件事没兴趣呢！

say:12:1220423007:0.text: I don't need these idiots kicking up dirt on the Whispers' turf.
say:12:1220423007:0.source_cn: 我只是不想让这些家伙把血薇帮的地盘搅得乱七八糟的。

say:13:1220423008:0.text: Lucca... you're... you're breaking the rules!
